name: Mirchi Baji ( 3 Pc )
description: Three farm-fresh long green chilies coated in a crispy golden batter and deep-fried to perfection. Non-spicy, crunchy, and irresistibly tasty.

name: Chow Chow Bath
description: A classic Karnataka combo of Khara Bath (spiced upma) and Kesari Bath (sweet semolina), served together for a perfect balance of savory and sweet. A must-try traditional breakfast delight.

name: Ghee Podi Thatte Idli
description: A soft, plate-sized idli generously topped with spicy podi (gunpowder) and a drizzle of aromatic ghee. A flavorful Karnataka specialty that melts in every bite.

name: Idli ( 2pc)
description: Two soft, melt-in-the-mouth steamed rice cakes, served with fresh chutney and aromatic sambar. A timeless South Indian favorite that’s light, healthy, and satisfying.

name: Idli Vada
description: A classic South Indian combo of two soft, fluffy idlis paired with one crispy golden vada. Served with fresh chutney and sambar for the perfect breakfast delight.

name: Kesari Bath
description: A traditional South Indian sweet made with roasted semolina, ghee, sugar, and flavored with saffron & cardamom. Rich, aromatic, and garnished with cashews & raisins for a delightful finish.

name: Khara Bath
description: A flavorful South Indian delicacy made with roasted semolina cooked in ghee, vegetables, and aromatic spices. Savory, wholesome, and best enjoyed hot with chutney.

name: Poori Sagu
description: Three fluffy pooris served with flavorful vegetable sagu and chutney. A wholesome South Indian classic.

name: Rava Idli
description: A soft and fluffy steamed idli made with roasted semolina, tempered spices, and a hint of yogurt. Light, tasty, and served with chutney & sambar for a classic South Indian experience.

name: Rice Bath ( Day's Special )
description: A flavorful South Indian rice delicacy cooked with aromatic spices, herbs, and vegetables. Wholesome, satisfying, and best enjoyed with chutney or raita.

name: Vada ( 1pc)
description: A crispy, golden fried South Indian lentil doughnut, crunchy outside and soft inside. Served with chutney and sambar for a flavorful bite.

name: Mangalore Buns ( 1 Pc)
description: A soft, fluffy, mildly sweet deep-fried bread made with ripe bananas, a coastal Karnataka specialty. Light, tasty, and perfect with chutney or sambar.

name: Thatte Idli ( 1pc)
description: A soft and fluffy plate-sized idli, steamed to perfection. Light, wholesome, and best enjoyed with chutney and sambar.

name: Jaggery Pongal
description: A traditional South Indian sweet made with rice, moong dal, and rich jaggery, flavored with ghee, cardamom, and garnished with cashews & raisins. A festive delicacy that’s both wholesome and indulgent.

name: Dahi Vada ( 1pc )
description: Soft lentil dumplings soaked in creamy yogurt, topped with tangy chutneys and spices. A refreshing North Indian favorite with the perfect sweet, tangy, and savory balance.

name: Akki Rotti
description: A traditional Karnataka specialty made with rice flour dough mixed with onions, green chilies, and fresh herbs, flattened and pan-roasted to perfection. Served hot with chutney, it’s a crispy and flavorful South Indian favorite.

name: Ragi Rotti
description: A healthy Karnataka delicacy made with finger millet (ragi) flour, onions, chilies, and fresh herbs, flattened and roasted on a hot griddle. Nutritious, earthy, and best enjoyed with chutney for a wholesome traditional meal.

name: Bisebele Bath
description: A classic Karnataka one-pot dish of rice, toor dal, and mixed vegetables simmered in a tangy tamarind base with a bold, aromatic spice mix. Rich, spicy, and comforting—often finished with ghee and served with boondi.

name: Breakfast Combo

name: Ghee Pudi Masala Dosa
description: A crispy dosa smeared with ghee and spiced chutney pudi, filled with flavorful potato masala. Paired perfectly with chutneys and hot sambar.

name: Masala Dosa
description: A South Indian classic – crispy dosa stuffed with mildly spiced potato masala. Best enjoyed with chutneys and sambar.

name: Plain Dosa
description: A classic South Indian delight – crisp dosa made from rice. Paired with tangy chutneys and aromatic sambar.

name: Rava Dosa
description: A thin, crispy dosa made from semolina and rice flour, seasoned with spices. Paired perfectly with chutneys and flavorful sambar.

name: Set Dosa
description: A set of 3 soft, spongy dosas infused with ghee. Paired perfectly with flavorful sagu and chutneys.

name: Butter Masala Dosa
description: South India’s favorite indulgence – butter-laden dosa filled with masala. Best savored with fresh chutneys and steaming sambar.

name: Onion Utappa
description: A wholesome South Indian uttapam with a colorful topping of onions and veggies. Paired perfectly with chutney and sagu.

name: Open Butter Masala Dosa
description: A crisp dosa topped with a rich spread of butter and spiced potato masala. Paired perfectly with chutneys and hot sambar.

name: Neer Dosa
description: A set of 2 soft and delicate coastal-style dosas. Paired perfectly with fresh chutney and sweet jaggery.

name: Mushroom Donne Biriyani
description: A fragrant Karnataka-style biryani cooked with tender mushrooms, aromatic basmati rice, and a blend of spices like cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaves. Finished with a touch of curd for creaminess, this biryani is served in a traditional donne (leaf bowl) for an authentic, flavorful experience

name: South Indian Thali
description: A wholesome platter featuring soft pooris, steamed rice, tangy sambar, spicy rasam, seasonal palya (vegetable stir-fry), flavorful sabzi, crispy papad, a traditional sweet, and pickle. A complete South Indian meal served with balance and variety in every bite.

name: Dal Khichadi
description: A comforting Indian one-pot meal of rice and moong dal simmered with mild spices, turmeric, and ghee. Soft, nourishing, and subtly spiced, it's often served with pickle.

name: Gungura Rice
description: A tangy and spicy South Indian rice dish made with cooked rice and gungura (sorrel) leaves sautéed with garlic, chilies, and tempered spices. Known for its bold, earthy flavor and signature sour kick unique to Andhra cuisine.

name: Lemon Rice
description: A light, zesty South Indian rice dish infused with fresh lemon juice, turmeric, green chilies, and tempered mustard seeds. Bright and aromatic, it's a quick, refreshing meal often paired with pickle.

name: Special Puliogare
description: A flavorful South Indian tamarind rice made with a rich blend of tamarind paste, jaggery, ground spices, and tempered mustard seeds, curry leaves, and peanuts. Balances tangy, spicy, and slightly sweet notes in every bite.

name: Gobi Manchurian
description: Crispy cauliflower florets tossed in a spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese sauce. A crowd-favorite starter that’s crunchy, flavorful, and pairs perfectly with noodles or fried rice.

name: Mushroom Chilly
description: Juicy mushrooms tossed in a spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese sauce with onions and peppers. A delicious appetizer that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

name: Mushroom Manchurian
description: Crispy golden mushrooms tossed in a spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese sauce. A flavorful appetizer that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

name: Paneer Chilly
description: Crispy fried paneer cubes tossed in a spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese sauce with onions and peppers. A flavorful appetizer that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

name: Paneer Kebab
description: Soft cubes of paneer marinated in a rich blend of yogurt, aromatic Indian spices, and herbs, then skewered and grilled or tandoor-cooked to perfection. Lightly charred on the outside and soft inside, this smoky, flavorful starter is a popular choice across Indian cuisine.

name: Paneer Manchurian
description: Crispy fried paneer cubes tossed in a spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese sauce. A vibrant and flavorful dish, perfect as a starter or appetizer with noodles or fried rice.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with a colorful mix of fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A classic Indo-Chinese favorite that’s quick, flavorful, and utterly satisfying.

name: Veg Schezwan Noodles
description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with crunchy vegetables in a fiery, tangy Schezwan sauce. A bold and flavorful Indo-Chinese favorite for spice lovers.

name: Butter Milk
description: A light, cooling yogurt-based drink spiced with herbs and cumin. Refreshing, healthy, and the perfect digestive after a hearty meal.

name: Chikku Milkshake
description: A rich and creamy milkshake made with ripe chikku (sapota), blended with chilled milk for a naturally sweet, malty flavor.

name: Fresh Lime Juice
description: A refreshing blend of fresh lime, chilled water, and a hint of salt. Light, tangy, and the perfect natural thirst-quencher — made with no sugar.

name: Sweet Lassi
description: A traditional North Indian yogurt-based drink, sweetened and blended to creamy perfection. Refreshing, cooling, and best enjoyed chilled.

name: Avocado Milkshake
description: A rich, creamy milkshake made with ripe avocados blended with chilled milk, offering a smooth texture and naturally buttery flavor.

name: Banana Milkshake
description: A creamy and wholesome shake made with ripe bananas and chilled milk, blended to perfection for a naturally sweet and filling treat.

name: Cold Badam Shake
description: A rich and creamy chilled milkshake made with almonds, flavored with saffron and cardamom. Refreshing, nutty, and perfectly indulgent.

name: Grape Milkshake
description: A creamy and refreshing blend of juicy grapes and chilled milk, creating a naturally sweet and fruity shake.

name: Muskmelon Milkshake
description: A creamy and refreshing milkshake made with ripe muskmelons, blended with chilled milk for a naturally sweet and fruity delight.

name: Pineapple Juice
description: Freshly pressed juice from ripe pineapples, bursting with natural tropical sweetness and tang. Refreshing, energizing, and best enjoyed chilled — with no added sugar.

name: Water Melon Juice
description: Freshly blended juice made from ripe, juicy watermelons. Naturally sweet, intensely hydrating, and perfectly refreshing when served chilled — no sugar added.

name: Butterscotch Milkshake
description: Smooth, creamy, and loaded with butterscotch flavor. Made with chilled milk, rich ice cream, and sweet butterscotch sauce, topped with caramel crunch. A cool, comforting treat that’s perfect for sweet cravings and Instagram-worthy sips!

name: Chocolate Milkshake
description: Thick, chilled, and irresistibly chocolaty! Made with rich cocoa, creamy ice cream, and smooth milk, blended to perfection. Topped with chocolate syrup and choco chips for that extra indulgence. A classic favorite for every chocolate lover!

name: Pista Milkshake
description: Creamy, nutty, and full of flavor! This refreshing pista milkshake is blended with rich pistachios, smooth ice cream, and chilled milk. Topped with crunchy nuts for that extra bite. A perfect pick for a tasty and energizing treat!

name: Strawberry Milkshake
description: Fresh, fruity, and full of flavor! Made with juicy strawberries, creamy ice cream, and chilled milk, blended into a smooth pink delight. Topped with strawberry syrup and soft cream – a perfect sip for berry lovers!

name: Vanila Milkshake
description: Simple, smooth, and timeless! Blended with creamy vanilla ice cream, fresh milk, and a hint of real vanilla essence. Served chilled and topped with whipped cream – a refreshing classic that never goes out of style!

name: Chutney (250ml)
description: A zesty South Indian condiment made from ground coconut, green chilies, and roasted lentils, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves. This 250ml serving adds a fresh, spicy kick to idli, dosa, or vada.

name: Pappu (250ml)

name: Rasam (250ml)

name: Sambhar (250ml)
description: A tangy, spiced South Indian lentil stew made with toor dal, tamarind, vegetables, and a robust blend of mustard seeds, curry leaves, and dried chilies. Typically served hot with rice, idli, or dosa. A flavorful 250ml portion.

name: Aloo Paratha
description: 2 golden, pan-fried whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes, served with creamy curd and tangy pickle for a classic, comforting North Indian breakfast or meal.

name: Paneer Paratha
description: 2 soft, golden-brown flatbreads filled with spiced grated paneer, served hot with creamy curd and tangy pickle—a hearty and flavorful North Indian delight perfect for any meal.

description: Creamy peanut butter and fresh banana with a hint of honey.

name: Bombay Sandwich

name: Pesto Paneer Grill
description: Grilled paneer sandwich with fresh basil pesto, veggies and butter.

name: Pesto Veg Grill
description: Grilled sandwich with basil pesto, tomato, capsicum and creamy mayo.

name: Paneer Ghee Roast With Neer Dosa
description: Soft paneer cubes slow-roasted in rich, aromatic ghee roast masala, served with delicate, lace-thin neer dosa. Prepared with no food colour, no oil — only 100% pure ghee for an authentic, wholesome coastal flavour.
